blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Transition Metals) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Which statement about the general physical properties of the first-row transition elements (titanium to copper) is incorrect?
(Pehli row ke transition elements (Ti se Cu) ki physical properties ke bare mein kaun sa bayan ghalat hai?)

options.text: In ki density aam tor par zyada hai.
Yeh room temperature par aam tor par naram (soft) thos hain.
Yeh garmi aur bijli ke achhe conductor hain.
In ke melting aur boiling points zyada hain.

blocks.explanation: Pehli row ki transition metals sakht aur mazboot (hard, rigid) thos hain, is liye “naram thos” ghalat hai. Zyada density, zyada melting/boiling point aur garmi/bijli guzarna sab durust hain.

blocks.prompt:
II. The ability of transition elements to behave as catalysts is primarily linked to which of their properties:
(Transition elements ka catalyst banna asal mein kis property se juda hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transition metals aur un ke compounds catalyst hain kyun ke yeh aasani se oxidation states badalte hain (Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺), reactant ke saath intermediate bana kar kam activation energy wala rasta dete hain aur phir wapas apni halat mein aa jaate hain.

blocks.prompt:
III. What is the reason for variable oxidation states in 3d transition metals?
(3d transition metals mein mukhtalif (variable) oxidation states ki wajah kya hai?)

options.text: 3d aur 4s subshells ki taqreeban barabar energy.

blocks.explanation: 3d aur 4s subshells ki energy bohat qareeb hai, is liye 4s electrons ke baad 3d ke bhi mukhtalif tadaad mein electrons nikal sakte hain aur kai oxidation states bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
IV. Which ionic configuration represents a metal that lost only its 4s electrons?
(Kis ion ne sirf apne 4s electrons khoye hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Fe = [Ar] 3d⁶4s² → Fe²⁺ = [Ar] 3d⁶: sirf do 4s electrons nikle.
Ti⁴⁺ (3d²4s² se), V⁵⁺ (3d³4s² se) aur Sc³⁺ (3d¹4s² se) ne 3d electrons bhi khoye hain.

blocks.prompt:
V. In the complex ion, [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻, what is coordination number of central metal ion?
([Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ mein markazi metal ion ka coordination number kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fe²⁺ chhe CN⁻ ligands se chhe dative bonds banata hai, is liye coordination number 6 hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. The colour displayed by a transition metal complex is a result of electrons moving between d-orbitals. This process is called a:
(Complex ka rang d-orbitals ke darmiyan electrons ke jaane se hai. Is amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Neeche wale d-orbital ka electron nazar aane wali roshni jazb kar ke oopar wale d-orbital mein jata hai: d-d transition. Nazar aane wala rang jazb hone wali roshni ka complementary (mukhalif) rang hai.

blocks.prompt:
VII. Adding excess ammonia to pink [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ gives a yellow solution. What other changes occur besides colour change?
(Gulabi [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ mein zyada ammonia dalne se peela solution banta hai. Rang ke ilawa aur kya badalta hai?)

options.text: Coordination number 6 se 4 ho jata hai
Co ki oxidation state +2 se +3 ho jati hai
d-orbital splitting (ΔE) ki miqdar badalti hai

blocks.explanation: [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 6NH₃ → [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺ + 6H₂O. NH₃ pani ki jagah leta hai: coordination number 6 hi rehta hai, cobalt +2 hi rehta hai aur product solution hai. Naya ligand splitting ΔE badal deta hai jis se rang badalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) mein “changes form +2 to +3” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “from” hai.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Which one of the following complex has different geometry than others?
(Kis complex ki geometry (shakal) baqiyon se mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: [CuCl₄]²⁻ mein chaar ligands hain aur yeh tetrahedral hai. Baqi teeno mein Cu²⁺ ke gird chhe ligands hain aur woh octahedral hain.

blocks.prompt:
IX. What geometry is typical when Co²⁺(aq) reacts with six monodentate anionic ligands?
(Co²⁺(aq) monodentate anionic ligands se reaction kare to aam shakal kya hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq aqueous cobalt(II) ions Cl⁻, OH⁻ aur SCN⁻ jaise monodentate anionic ligands ke saath aam tor par tetrahedral complexes banate hain, maslan [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ → [CoCl₄]²⁻ (neela, tetrahedral). “Six” ke bare mein Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein “six monodentate anionic ligands” likha hai, lekin jis complex mein chhe ligands jure hon woh octahedral hota hai. Anionic ligands wale tetrahedral Co²⁺ complexes, jaise [CoCl₄]²⁻, mein chaar ligands hain; chhe ligands wala to shuru ka [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ hai. Key (d) chapter ke bayan ke mutabiq hai; sawal ko “monodentate anionic ligands (maslan Cl⁻) se reaction” samjhein.

blocks.prompt:
X. Optical isomers are characterized by their ability to rotate plane-polarized light. The isomer that rotates light to the right is called:
(Jo optical isomer roshni ko daen taraf ghumaye use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jo isomer plane-polarized light ko daen (clockwise) ghumaye woh dextrorotatory (+) hai; baen ghumane wala laevorotatory (–).

blocks.prompt:
a) Why is zinc not included in the transition metals, although it shows electronic configuration with d-orbitals and also the member of d-block?
Zinc d-block mein hone ke bawajood transition metal kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Transition element ke liye kam az kam aik stable oxidation state mein d subshell adhoori (partially filled) honi chahiye. Zinc sirf aik ion Zn²⁺ ([Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s⁰) banata hai jis ki 3d subshell poori bhari hai (Zn atom bhi 3d¹⁰). Is liye zinc d-block element hai magar transition element nahi.

blocks.prompt:
b) What is the correlation between the ability of transition elements to exhibit variable oxidation states and their electron configuration.
Variable oxidation states aur electron configuration ka aapas mein kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation: 3d aur 4s subshells ki energy qareeb qareeb hai. 3d metal pehle 4s electrons khota hai (aam tor par +2) aur phir 3d ke mukhtalif tadaad mein electrons kho kar oonchi states banata hai. Jitne zyada 3d + 4s electrons, utni oonchi zyada se zyada state (Mn, 3d⁵4s², +7 tak); is se row mein parabolic (pehle barhta phir ghatta) trend banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) How do transition metals function as effective catalysts. Give some examples.
Transition metals achhe catalyst kaise hain? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Variable oxidation states: metal ion aasani se state badalta hai (Fe²⁺ ⇌ Fe³⁺), reactant ke saath na-pukhta (unstable) intermediate bana kar wapas apni halat mein aata hai aur kam energy wala rasta deta hai (homogeneous catalysis); maslan acetylene se acrylic acid banane mein nickel salts (Ni(0)/Ni(II)).
2. Khali, qabil-e-rasai d-orbitals: reactants metal ki satah par sahi rukh mein chipak jaate hain aur activation energy kam hoti hai (heterogeneous catalysis); maslan Haber process mein iron (N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃).

blocks.prompt:
d) Why the complex [Cr(en)₃]³⁺ is more stable than [Cr(H₂O)₆]³⁺?
[Cr(en)₃]³⁺ [Cr(H₂O)₆]³⁺ se zyada stable kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: en (H₂NCH₂CH₂NH₂) bidentate ligand hai: har en do N atoms se jur kar Cr³⁺ ke saath chhalla (ring) banata hai (chelation), jab ke H₂O monodentate hai. Polydentate ligands wale complexes ka stability constant bohat zyada hota hai (chelate effect), is liye [Cr(en)₃]³⁺ zyada stable hai. (Chapter se aage: 3 en 6 H₂O ki jagah lete hain, azaad zarron ki tadaad barhti hai jo chelate ke haq mein hai.)

blocks.prompt:
e) Define a complex and the nature of the bond between its components.
Complex ki tareef aur us ke hisson ke darmiyan bond ki noiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Complex (coordination compound) woh molecule ya ion hai jis mein markazi metal atom/ion ke gird electron pair dene wale ligands hon, maslan [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻. Har ligand apna lone pair metal ke khali d-orbital mein deta hai aur coordinate covalent (dative) bond banta hai: ligand Lewis base, metal ion Lewis acid.

blocks.prompt:
f) What is the coordination number? Give this number for [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻.
Coordination number kya hai? [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ ke liye batayein.
blocks.explanation: Complex mein ligands aur markazi metal atom/ion ke darmiyan dative bonds ki kul tadaad coordination number hai. [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ mein Fe²⁺ chhe CN⁻ se jura hai, is liye coordination number 6 hai.

blocks.prompt:
g) Define a bidentate ligand and state how many bonds it forms to the central ion.
Bidentate ligand ki tareef karein; yeh markazi ion se kitne bond banata hai?
blocks.explanation: Bidentate ligand do donor atoms se do electron pairs de sakta hai, is liye do coordinate bonds banata hai. Misalein: 1,2-diaminoethane (en, do N atoms) aur ethanedioate ion C₂O₄²⁻ (do O atoms).

blocks.prompt:
h) Draw the structure of EDTA ligand and label its electron pair donating sites.
EDTA ki structure banayein aur electron pair dene wali jagahein batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Structure (alfaz mein): EDTA⁴⁻ = (⁻OOCCH₂)₂N–CH₂–CH₂–N(CH₂COO⁻)₂: do N atoms –CH₂–CH₂– se jure, har N par do –CH₂COO⁻ baazu.
Donor jagahein (chhe): dono N atoms ka aik aik lone pair, aur chaaron carboxylate groups ka aik aik O⁻. Is liye EDTA hexadentate ligand hai, maslan Ca²⁺ + EDTA⁴⁻ → [Ca(EDTA)]²⁻.

blocks.prompt:
i) Draw the colour wheel used to predict the colour of transition metal complexes. Also pair up the complementary colours with each other.
Colour wheel banayein aur complementary rangon ke jore batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Colour wheel (alfaz mein): daire ke chhe barabar hisse is tarteeb mein: orange, yellow, green, blue, violet, red. Aamne saamne wale rang complementary hain:
Orange ↔ Blue
Yellow ↔ Violet
Green ↔ Red
Complex us rang ka nazar aata hai jo jazb hone wali roshni ka complementary ho, maslan yellow jazb kare to violet nazar aaye.

blocks.prompt:
j) Define Kstab. How it reflects the stability of coordination complexes?
Kstab ki tareef karein. Yeh complexes ki stability kaise batata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Kstab solution mein hydrated metal ion aur naye ligand se complex ion banne ka equilibrium constant hai, maslan
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O
Kstab = [[CuCl₄]²⁻] / ([[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺][Cl⁻]⁴) (pani shamil nahi)
Jitna zyada Kstab (log₁₀ Kstab), utna stable complex aur equilibrium daen taraf: [CuCl₄]²⁻ 5.6 < ammonia complex 13.1 < [Cu(EDTA)]²⁻ 18.8.

blocks.prompt:
k) How coordination number 4 has two shapes i.e., tetrahedral and square planar?
Coordination number 4 ki do shakalein (tetrahedral aur square planar) kaise hoti hain?
blocks.explanation:
Chaar ligands ke saath shakal metal ion ki electronic configuration aur ligands ki qisam par munhasir hai:
Square planar (90°): d⁸ ions (Ni²⁺, Pt²⁺) NH₃ aur CN⁻ jaise ligands ke saath, maslan [Ni(CN)₄]²⁻, [Pt(NH₃)₄]²⁺.
Tetrahedral (109.5°): d⁷, d⁸, d¹⁰ ions mein aam, aksar Cl⁻ ke saath, maslan [CoCl₄]²⁻, [MnCl₄]²⁻.

blocks.prompt:
l) Illustrate the type of isomerism shown by [PtNH₃)₂Cl₂] complex.
[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] kis qisam ki isomerism dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation:
[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] square planar hai aur geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism dikhata hai:
cis (cisplatin): dono Cl (aur dono NH₃) saath wale konon par, 90°; polar.
trans (transplatin): dono Cl aamne saamne, 180°; bond dipoles khatam, non-polar.
In ki properties mukhtalif hain: sirf cisplatin cancer ki dawa hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Formula “[PtNH₃)₂Cl₂]” mein aik bracket ghayab hai; sahi [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] hai.

blocks.prompt:
m) Give medicinal importance of cis-plantin.
Cisplatin ki tibbi ahmiyat batayein.
blocks.explanation: Cisplatin, cis-[Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂], cancer ki dawa hai. Cell ke andar pani is ke chloride ligands ki jagah le leta hai; yeh “active” dawa DNA ke guanine bases se jur kar double helix ko aapas mein jor (cross-link) deti hai. Is se tezi se taqseem hone wale cancer cells mein DNA ki nakal ruk jati hai aur cell khud khatam (apoptosis) ho jata hai. Transplatin mein yeh asar nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “cis-plantin” ghalat chhapa hai; dawa ka naam cisplatin hai.

blocks.prompt:
n) What happens when excess of ammonia solution is added to Co(II) hydroxide precipitates?
Co(II) hydroxide ke precipitate mein zyada ammonia solution dalne se kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Neela cobalt(II) hydroxide precipitate hal ho jata hai: NH₃ ligands pani aur hydroxide ki jagah lete hain (ligand exchange) aur hal hone wala hexaamminecobalt(II) ion banta hai; solution peela ho jata hai:
[Co(H₂O)₄(OH)₂](s) + 6NH₃(aq) → [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺(aq) + 4H₂O(l) + 2OH⁻(aq)

blocks.prompt:
o) Is there any effect of excessive dilution of complexes? If yes then justify how does dilution affect the position of equilibrium in ligand ion exchange reactions?
Kya complexes ko bohat patla (dilute) karne ka asar hota hai? Equilibrium par asar samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Haan. Ligand exchange aik equilibrium hai, maslan [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O. Bohat sara pani dalne se naye ligand (Cl⁻) ka concentration kam aur pani ligand zyada ho jata hai, is liye Le Chatelier's principle ke mutabiq equilibrium baen taraf jata hai aur asal hydrated ion dobara banta hai (peela-hara se wapas neela).

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar likhne wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
a) Discuss the two types of stereoisomerism found in transition metal complexes. Use the examples [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (square planar) and [Ni(NH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂)₃]²⁺ (octahedral) to illustrate the key structural differences that give rise to geometrical and optical isomerism, respectively.
Complexes mein stereoisomerism ki do qismein [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] aur [Ni(en)₃]²⁺ ki misal se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Stereoisomers ka formula aur bonds aik jaise, lekin ligands ki khala (space) mein tarteeb mukhtalif hoti hai.
1. Geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism, [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (square planar): Pt aur chaar ligands aik hi plane mein 90° par. cis mein dono Cl saath saath (90°), trans mein aamne saamne (180°). Bond tore baghair yeh aapas mein nahi badalte aur properties mukhtalif hain: cis polar (cisplatin, cancer ki dawa), trans non-polar.
2. Optical isomerism, [Ni(NH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂)₃]²⁺ (octahedral): teen bidentate en ligands Ni²⁺ ke gird pankhe (propeller) ki tarah lipatte hain; do shakalein banti hain jo aik doosre ki aaina shakal hain aur aik doosre par poori nahi baithteen (enantiomers). Properties aik jaisi, sirf aik plane-polarized light ko daen (+) aur doosra baen (–) ghumata hai.
Asal farq: geometrical isomers mein aik jaise ligands ki jagah (90° ya 180°) badalti hai; optical isomers aaina shakalein hain, jo tab mumkin hain jab complex mein symmetry ka plane na ho, jaise teen bidentate ligands ke saath.

rows: Aik jaise ligands mukhtalif jagah (cis 90°, trans 180°)
Aaine ki shakalein jo aik doosre par poori na baithen (enantiomers)
Square planar aur octahedral complexes, maslan [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂]
Bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes, maslan [Ni(en)₃]²⁺
Physical aur chemical properties mukhtalif (dipole moment, dawai ka asar)
Properties aik jaisi, sirf polarized light ko ghumane ki simt mukhtalif

blocks.prompt:
b) The reaction between Cu²⁺ and I⁻ results in a solid precipitate of CuI and aqueous I₂.
a) Write down the two relevant reduction half-equations and their E° values (provided in the text).
b) Explain why comparing only the E° values suggests the reaction is not feasible as written.
c) Use Le Chatelier's principle to explain why the reaction proceeds forward in practice.
Cu²⁺ aur I⁻ ka reaction: half-equations aur E°; E° ke hisaab se feasible kyun nahi lagta; Le Chatelier se aage kyun barhta hai?
blocks.explanation:
a) Reduction half-equations (text se):
½I₂(aq) + e⁻ → I⁻(aq)  E° = +0.54 V
Cu²⁺(aq) + e⁻ → Cu⁺(aq)  E° = +0.15 V
b) 2Cu²⁺ + 4I⁻ → 2CuI + I₂ mein Cu²⁺ ka reduction aur I⁻ ka oxidation hona chahiye:
E°cell = E°(reduction) − E°(oxidation) = 0.15 − 0.54 = −0.39 V
E°cell negative hai; I₂/I⁻ ka E° zyada hai, is liye I₂ ka reduction hona chahiye tha, yani likha hua reaction feasible nahi lagta.
c) Banne wala Cu⁺ foran na-hal safed precipitate CuI ban kar nikal jata hai. Product hatne se [Cu⁺] kam hota hai, Le Chatelier's principle ke mutabiq equilibrium daen taraf khisakta rehta hai aur reaction aage barhta hai (bhoora-surkh I₂ banta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Le Chatelier's principle: agar kisi equilibrium se aik product nikal diya jaye to system wohi product dobara banane ki taraf (aage) chalta hai. Yahan precipitate banna Cu⁺ ko nikalne ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) Using the examples [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ and [Fe(CN)₆]³⁻, demonstrate how to predict the formula and overall charge of a complex ion. Clearly explain the role of the central metal ion charge, ligand charge, and coordination number in determining the final result for both examples.
[Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ aur [Fe(CN)₆]³⁻ ki misal se complex ion ka formula aur charge maloom karna samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Usool: complex ka charge = metal ion ka charge + (coordination number × aik ligand ka charge). Coordination number monodentate ligands ki tadaad hai jo subscript mein likhi jati hai; formula mein pehle metal, phir ligands, square brackets ke andar.
[Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺: metal Co³⁺ (+3); ligand NH₃ (ammine), neutral (0); coordination number 6 → Co(NH₃)₆.
Charge = (+3) + 6 × (0) = +3 → [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺ (cationic complex)
[Fe(CN)₆]³⁻: metal Fe³⁺ (+3); ligand CN⁻ (cyano), −1; coordination number 6 → Fe(CN)₆.
Charge = (+3) + 6 × (−1) = −3 → [Fe(CN)₆]³⁻ (anionic complex)
Neutral ligand metal ka charge nahi badalta, anionic ligands charge kam kar ke complex ko negative bana sakte hain. (Fe²⁺ ke saath yahi ligands [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ dete hain.)

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Explain the factors that determine the specific geometry (shape) of a transition metal complex.
Transition metal complex ki khaas shakal (geometry) tay karne wale factors bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Complexes ki shakal in cheezon se tay hoti hai:
1. Coordination number (jure hue donor atoms ki tadaad):
• 2 → linear, 180°: [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺, [Ag(CN)₂]⁻
• 4 → tetrahedral (109.5°) ya square planar (90°)
• 6 → octahedral, chaar ligands square plane mein 90° par aur do oopar neeche 180° par: [Cr(NH₃)₆]³⁺, [Co(en)₃]³⁺ (sab se aam shakal)
2. Metal ion ki electronic configuration: Ni²⁺ aur Pt²⁺ jaise d⁸ ions square planar complexes dete hain ([Ni(CN)₄]²⁻, [Pt(NH₃)₄]²⁺); tetrahedral complexes d⁷, d⁸ aur d¹⁰ ions mein aam hain ([CoCl₄]²⁻, [MnCl₄]²⁻).
3. Ligands ki qisam: aik hi ion ligand badalne se shakal badal sakta hai. [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ aur [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ octahedral hain, lekin Cl⁻ ke saath tetrahedral [CuCl₄]²⁻ aur [CoCl₄]²⁻ bante hain; Ni²⁺ CN⁻ ke saath square planar hai. (Chapter se aage: Cl⁻ jaise bare ligands aapas mein jagah gherte hain, is liye kam ligands fit hote hain.)

blocks.prompt:
Q3. Describe the splitting of d-orbitals and colour formation in octahedral and tetrahedral complexes.
Octahedral aur tetrahedral complexes mein d-orbitals ki splitting aur rang banne ka amal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Azaad metal ion mein paanchon d-orbitals (dxy, dxz, dyz, dx²−y², dz²) ki energy barabar (degenerate) hoti hai. Ligands qareeb aayen to un ka electric field inhein do mukhtalif energy wale sets mein taqseem (split) kar deta hai; farq ΔE (Δ) hai.
Octahedral (chhe ligands axes par, maslan [Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺): dx²−y² aur dz² ligands ki taraf hain is liye oopar (do ka set); dxy, dxz, dyz neeche (teen ka set).
Tetrahedral (chaar ligands, maslan [CuCl₄]²⁻): tarteeb ulti, dxy, dxz, dyz oopar aur dx²−y², dz² neeche, aur splitting octahedral se kam.
Rang banna: neeche wale set ka electron ΔE = hν = hc/λ energy wali nazar aane wali roshni jazb kar ke oopar wale set mein jata hai (d-d transition). Bachi hui roshni guzar jati hai aur hamein complementary rang nazar aata hai (yellow jazb → violet nazar; red/orange jazb → blue ya green nazar).
Ligand ΔE par asar karta hai: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻. Zyada ΔE par oonchi frequency (violet/blue) jazb hoti hai aur complex peela dikhta hai; kam ΔE par red/orange jazb hoti hai aur blue ya green dikhta hai. Is liye ligand ya shakal badalne se rang badalta hai.

rows: Chhe ligands x, y, z axes par
Chaar ligands tetrahedron ke konon par
Neeche wala set: dxy, dxz, dyz (teen)
Oopar wala set: dxy, dxz, dyz (teen)

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Compare the reactions of conc. HCl with aqueous Cu²⁺ and aqueous Co²⁺. Include equations, colour/geometry changes, and the reason for different colours.
Conc. HCl ke aqueous Cu²⁺ aur Co²⁺ se reactions ka muqabla equations, rang/shakal ki tabdeeli aur wajah ke saath karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cu²⁺(aq) asal mein [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ (neela) aur Co²⁺(aq) [Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺ (gulabi) hai. Conc. HCl qatra qatra dalne se Cl⁻ milta hai jo pani ligands ki jagah leta hai (ligand exchange):
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 4Cl⁻(aq) → [CuCl₄]²⁻(aq) + 6H₂O(l): neela → peela (peela-hara) solution
[Co(H₂O)₆]²⁺(aq) + 4Cl⁻(aq) → [CoCl₄]²⁻(aq) + 6H₂O(l): gulabi → neela solution
Dono mein chhe pani ligands ki jagah chaar Cl⁻: coordination number 6 → 4, shakal octahedral → tetrahedral, charge 2+ → 2−.
Rangon ki wajah: naya ligand aur nayi shakal d-orbital splitting ΔE badal dete hain. Cl⁻ pani se kam splitting karta hai aur tetrahedral splitting octahedral se kam hai, is liye mukhtalif frequency ki roshni jazb hoti hai aur mukhtalif complementary rang dikhta hai. Cu²⁺ (d⁹) aur Co²⁺ (d⁷) mein d-electrons aur splitting mukhtalif hai, is liye un ke chloro complexes ke rang (peela aur neela) alag hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Describe the various redox reactions that takes place in transition metal complex ions?
Transition metal complex ions mein hone wale mukhtalif redox reactions bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Transition metals kai oxidation states mein hoti hain, is liye un ke ions redox reactions karte hain. Feasibility standard electrode potentials se: E°cell = E°(reduction) − E°(oxidation); E°cell positive ho to reaction mumkin (feasible). Zyada positive E° wala half-reaction reduce hota hai.
1. Acidified manganate(VII) aur ethanedioate:
MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ + 5e⁻ → Mn²⁺ + 4H₂O  E° = +1.52 V (×2)
C₂O₄²⁻ → 2CO₂ + 2e⁻ (×5)
2MnO₄⁻ + 16H⁺ + 5C₂O₄²⁻ → 2Mn²⁺ + 10CO₂ + 8H₂O
E°cell = 1.52 − (−0.49) = +2.01 V: feasible; MnO₄⁻ oxidizing agent, C₂O₄²⁻ reducing agent.
2. Manganate(VII) aur iron(II):
MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ + 5e⁻ → Mn²⁺ + 4H₂O  E° = +1.52 V
Fe³⁺ + e⁻ → Fe²⁺  E° = +0.77 V (ulta aur ×5)
MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ + 5Fe²⁺ → Mn²⁺ + 5Fe³⁺ + 4H₂O
E°cell = 1.52 − 0.77 = +0.75 V: feasible.
3. Copper(II) aur iodide:
2Cu²⁺(aq) + 4I⁻(aq) → 2CuI(s) (safed) + I₂(aq) (bhoora-surkh)
Cu²⁺ + e⁻ → Cu⁺ E° = +0.15 V; ½I₂ + e⁻ → I⁻ E° = +0.54 V
E°cell = 0.15 − 0.54 = −0.39 V, phir bhi reaction aage barhta hai kyun ke CuI precipitate ban kar Cu⁺ ko nikal deta hai (Le Chatelier's principle). Banne wali I₂ ko thiosulphate se titrate kiya ja sakta hai.
(Chapter mein 2CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ ke liye +0.49 V aur Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ ke liye −0.77 V, aur E°cell +1.03 V aur +2.29 V chhape hain; chapter ke apne correction notes wale durust values yahan istemal hui hain.)

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Explain the stereoisomerism with its types in transition metal complexes.
Transition metal complexes mein stereoisomerism aur us ki qismein bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Stereoisomers woh complexes hain jin ka formula aur bonds aik jaise, lekin ligands ki khala mein tarteeb mukhtalif ho. Do qismein:
1. Geometrical (cis-trans) isomerism: aik jaise ligands saath wali jagah (cis, 90°) ya aamne saamne (trans, 180°). Square planar aur octahedral complexes mein.
• [Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂] (square planar): cis (cisplatin) mein dono Cl saath saath aur yeh polar hai; trans (transplatin) mein aamne saamne, dipoles khatam, non-polar. Cisplatin cancer ki dawa hai, transplatin nahi.
• [Co(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]³⁺ (MA₄B₂ octahedral): cis (do H₂O 90° par) aur trans (180°); sirf do geometrical isomers. Isi tarah [Co(NH₃)₄Cl₂]⁺.
2. Optical isomerism: isomers aik doosre ki aaina shakal hain jo aik doosre par poori nahi baithteen (enantiomers). Bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes mein aam, maslan [Ni(NH₂CH₂CH₂NH₂)₃]²⁺ ([Ni(en)₃]²⁺). Enantiomers ki properties aik jaisi, sirf plane-polarized light ko ulti simton mein ghumate hain: dextrorotatory (+) daen, laevorotatory (–) baen.

rows: Aik jaise ligands mukhtalif jagah (cis 90°, trans 180°)
Aaine ki shakalein jo aik doosre par poori na baithen (enantiomers)

Bidentate ligands wale octahedral complexes, maslan [Ni(en)₃]²⁺
